text_block_list.text:
The day of the Fan Appreciation Festival 
has arrived. As for the event Mihono 
Bourbon is participating in—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: It's the Poker Face Championship.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It is a competition to see how well 
one can maintain a poker face in the face 
of fear and surprise.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I was chosen as the class representative 
for that.

Mihono Bourbon certainly keeps a poker 
face. She's so expressionless that people 
even whisper rumors of her being a robot.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Every member of the winning class will 
receive a voucher for a free carrot 
parfait.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To deepen my bond with my classmates by 
eating parfaits together— I will ensure 
our victory.
...she said, looking unusually serious!

And with that, the academy's proudest 
poker faces gathered together—and the 
championship began!

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text:
Who on earth will take the crown?! Without 
further ado, let's get right into it!

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text:
First obstacle: The Haunted House! If you 
can reach the goal with a poker face, you 
pass!

text_block_list.name: Participating Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Eeeek!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Complete blockage of light confirmed. 
Poor visibility, caution required.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Staff approaching from the front. 
Initiating verbal contact.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Ghost Actor
text_block_list.text: Spooky... spooky... ghost...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Please watch your step as you 
proceed.

Even so, it seems the first checkpoint was 
quite a difficult hurdle for most—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: No way, no way...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I told you I wasn't cut out for this...!

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text:
People are dropping out one after another 
from sheer terror! Over half the 
participants have been eliminated!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Um, did we clear it...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Mission complete.

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let's keep moving along! Next up 
is—

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text:
"Super spicy ramen! If you can finish the 
whole bowl with a poker face, you pass!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ......Transitioning to status "Painful."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...! Some water, please...

There were many dropouts this time around 
as well—

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text:
A shocking conclusion! With only the final 
match remaining, the one left standing is—

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text: Only two people!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Sensing the aura of victory.

text_block_list.name: Expressionless Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I will not lose.

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text:
A-And so, here is the third barrier! 
Express your feelings to the one you hold 
dear!

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text:
If you can get the message across with a 
poker face, you pass! Alright then, 
Bourbon-san, you're up first!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
A precious person... in other words, 
Master.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Um... Master always devotes herself 
earnestly to her training."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
From early morning until late at night, I 
am doing everything in my power for the 
sake of victory.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master's reliability and warmth have 
always supported me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Words cannot fully express just how 
grateful I a—
—Just then, a gust of wind swept through—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: *Achoo!*

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text: Mihono Bourbon has been disqualified—!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Kh...! The parfait...!

I couldn't win, but my heart felt 
strangely warm.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Um... Master always devotes herself 
earnestly to her training."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
From early morning until late at night, I 
am doing everything in my power for the 
sake of victory.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Master's reliability and warmth have 
always supported me.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Words cannot fully express just how 
grateful I am. Master.

That Mihono Bourbon is deeply precious to 
me too, and that she gives me courage—

Forgetting that the championship was even 
happening, I expressed every bit of 
gratitude I could think of.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master...

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Mihono Bourbon! Her tail, her tail is 
wagging high up in the air~~!

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text:
She can't hide her joy at all! Could this 
call for an inquiry?! No, but still!

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text: It didn't hit the face, so safe!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

After that, the other Umamusume got 
embarrassed halfway through expressing her 
gratitude to her Trainer—

text_block_list.name: PF Championship Executive Committee
text_block_list.text: The winner is Mihono Bourbonーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...! I did it, Master...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Now I can enjoy carrot parfaits with 
everyone in the class.

Seeing Mihono Bourbon look unusually happy 
brought a smile to my face without even 
realizing it.
